cards.title: Reproduce on a real PTY
cards.text: Run the failing unit, integration, or fuzz target against a real UNIX socket and PTY before patching.

cards.title: Run untrusted checks freely
cards.text: Anyone can run smthrs ci and uphill locally with read-only cache hits. Untrusted runs never write cache or skip gates.

cards.title: Open one focused change
cards.text: Use the Smithers Cloud MCP server to file issues, draft TODOs, and link stacked changesets with credit preserved.

cards.title: Trusted gate and auto release
cards.text: A maintainer approves and runs trusted gates. Merging to GitHub publishes binaries, docs, llms.txt, and the audit report.

blocks.title: zmux
blocks.tagline: Headless PTY multiplexer and terminal intelligence daemon in Zig with JSON-RPC, MCP, and SDKs.
blocks.text: A zero-dependency daemon owns sessions, windows, panes, PTYs, and a pure-Zig VT100/OSC screen engine so native apps, web terminals, and coding agents attach, inspect screens, and run commands without shelling out to tmux.

announcement.label: v0.5.0: Pure-Zig VT screen engine, kqueue/epoll reactor, unified zmux CLI + MCP, TS/Python/C SDKs

blocks.title: Quick start with unified zmux CLI
blocks.code:
zmux work
zmux exec work "zig build test"
zmux screen work --format plain
zmux mcp

blocks.title: Embed in Zig or C99

cards.title: Structured JSON-RPC and OpenRPC 1.3.2
cards.text: 39 typed RPCs and 13 push notifications with explicit error kinds. No format strings or screen-scraping.

cards.title: Pure-Zig VT100 and OSC intelligence
cards.text: Stateful screen grid, lossless TUI reattach, OSC 7 CWD, OSC 133 prompts, and agent status tracking.

cards.title: Agent-native primitives and MCP
cards.text: Server-side pane.wait, pane.exec, pane.signal, asciicast recording, and zero-dep zmux mcp stdio server.

cards.title: Zero-poll kqueue and epoll reactor
cards.text: Kernel event loops eliminate PTY exit polling on macOS and Linux while preserving owner-only socket security.

cards.title: Official TypeScript, Python, and C99 SDKs
cards.text: Zero-dependency TS/Bun/Node SDK with xterm adapter and zmux-ws bridge, Python sync/async SDK, and libzmux.a.

cards.title: Lighthouse backpressure
cards.text: Continuous Uphill audits score footprint, TigerStyle, correctness, test coverage, and docs on every change.
